Name: Farm Hot Spring
Author: xetyaj
Description:
This mod adds a lovely, natural hot spring to your farm, and you don't have to give up your farm cave to have it. 

The existing cave entrance on your vanilla farm now leads to a private, natural hot spring. Here you can relax to refresh your health and energy, as with any swimming area in the game. Fishing here is a waste of your time, but the panning opportunities are certainly worthwhile. Your farm cave is accessible through a cave entrance in the north wall of the hot spring enclosure, and Demetrius' offer to attract either bats or mushrooms to the space will not be impacted.

All vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded farm types are supported, but [u]you do need to make sure you select your farm type from the configuration options[/u]. For this reason, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] is highly recommended, though it is not a required dependency of the mod.

INSTALLATION
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3642]Event Repeater[/url]
4. Remove any previous versions of this mod that you may have in your installation.
5.. Download the latest version of the Hot Spring and unzip the archive.
6.. Place the new mod folder into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
7.. Run the game using SMAPI.
